title: Practice: Compound numerals in every case

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: She is around twenty years of age.
exercises.why: Numerals ending in soft sign (5–20 and 30) are declined like feminine nouns ending in soft sign (ночь, площадь etc.). The word один follows the rule of animate and inanimate nouns even when it appears at the end of a compound numeral: *Я вижу двадцать один самолёт. Я вижу двадцать одного студента.* However, два (две), три, четыре appearing at the end of the compound numerals do not follow the above pattern in the Accusative case. Their Accusative (both animate and inanimate) is usually the same as the Nominative: *Я вижу двадцать два самолёта. Я вижу двадцать два студента. Я знаю тридцать пять человек. Тысяча (fem.) and миллион (masc.) are used and declined as nouns and have both singular… — DLI, Lesson 71.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Numerals ending in soft sign (5–20 and 30) are declined like feminine nouns ending in soft sign (ночь, площадь etc.). (DLI, Lesson 71)
